status: Read-only planning; implementation interfaces pending root/architect verdict.

existingState.worldCatalog: FolderCatalog.WorldFolderEntry accepts only InitialWorld and createWorldFolderReader returns a frozen static singleton list.
existingState.worldView: WorldFolderView uses the same open-initial-world DOM ID for every catalog item; safe textContent for labels.
existingState.routing: WorldFolderBuilder.openWorld refuses IDs other than InitialWorld; runtime is deactivated/destroyed before deferred after-draw return.
existingState.accountStorage: AccountStartupStorage persists only PrologueCompleted under neurou-account-milestone-v1: plus encodeURIComponent(accountId).
existingState.worldShape: WorldInstance currently holds only id/kind/formatTime/themeColor; it is not a directory registry/persistence implementation.
existingState.permissions: WorldFork/CopyPermission frozen names exist in NAMEBOOK; no corresponding production implementation exists.
existingState.ledger: DirectorSession owns an in-memory append-only ledgerEvents list. World runtime destruction currently discards that session.

recommendedBoundaries: Account-specific local registry key, independent of account milestone and global editor draft keys.
Pure registry state and strict immutable reader snapshots separated from browser localStorage adapter.
Create candidate then persist successfully before publishing candidate state.
Unique durable world ID rather than title or list index; never reuse IDs retained by tombstones.
Delete marks a tombstone and active list excludes it; full registry snapshot retains record metadata and existing payload.
Opening a card revalidates current account, requested world ID and active/nondeleted state; a stale card is not authorization.
Keep WorldFork/CopyPermission and completion-derived permissions frozen without adding routes or granting capabilities.
Preserve InitialWorld routing and B1 chart Inspector settings for every actual gameplay runtime.
Explicitly settle whether ledger preservation is just no mutation of existing records or new actual gameplay persistence; current ledger is not durable.

plannedChecks.scenario: Empty account startup loads InitialWorld exactly once and only after PrologueCompleted; startup milestone key unchanged.
Create two distinct local worlds; live reader and fresh/reloaded registry list display both with safe titles and stable identities.
Accounts A and B cannot read/open/create/delete one another's worlds; encoded account storage keys avoid delimiter collisions.
World IDs stay unique across repeated calls, title reuse, reload and retained tombstones; injected collision or exhausted source rejects without replacing records.
Invalid IDs/titles/unknown schema fields/duplicate IDs/owner mismatch/illegal tombstones reject transactionally and preserve prior snapshots.
Storage read/write/JSON parse failures show a recoverable error and never silently invent an empty registry, ghost world or successful deletion.
Delete leaves tombstoned record and existing associated record payload byte-identical except deletion fact; active list drops it and reload preserves tombstone.
Unknown ID, stale card, already deleted world, InitialWorld deletion (if protected by verdict), and cross-account entry refuse without runtime creation.
Repeated deletion is idempotent, does not reset deletion time or reduce/rewrite events; failed delete persistence leaves world active.
Dynamic view IDs and data-world-id route exact records; malicious HTML title/account strings render text only.
Leaving world/editor deactivates input and frame driver immediately, retires runtime once, and refreshes current registry after actual after-draw destruction.
Opening each world carries same B1 UseGuidanceChart/ChartResourcePath/GuideTransparency config; director completes v3 with baseline T6 +1 and completion exactly +1.
No WorldFork/copy permission routes, no creation/deletion ledger append and no unintended account milestone or editor draft modification.
Fresh browser instance reload persistence and account isolation under actual Creator preview; actual two-resolution UI evidence is separate from pure logic.

scriptPolicy: Tests only in quality-review/b2-local-worlds. Pure logic loads actual TypeScript in memory; cc/storage mocks simulate only declared environmental boundaries. No production files, docs, NAMEBOOK, references or editor core modifications by this agent.
